question.en: Where are the circuits, and when is exposure?

summary.en: Construction, pixel design and exposure timing describe different aspects.
summary.zh-cn: 器件结构、像素设计和曝光时序描述不同方面。

boundary.en: BSI and stacked describe construction. Rolling and global shutter describe exposure timing; stacked does not automatically mean global shutter.
boundary.zh-cn: BSI 和堆栈描述器件结构，卷帘与全局快门描述曝光时序；堆栈不自动等于全局快门。

en: Front- and back-illumination describe the layout through which light reaches the photosensitive region. Stacked structures place pixel and circuit functions on separate layers. These can coexist. Exposure timing is a separate specification: consult the device documentation instead of inferring it from a construction label.
zh-cn: 前照式与背照式描述光到达感光区域时的器件布局，堆栈结构将像素和电路功能安排在不同层上，这些属性可以同时存在。曝光时序是独立规格，应查器件文档，不能根据结构名称推断。

sources.supports: Location of wiring relative to incident light in front- and back-illuminated CMOS structures.

sources.title: Sony Semiconductor Solutions — Stacked Structure
sources.supports: Stacking pixel and circuit sections; this does not by itself specify exposure timing.
